g.text: Down Home Creole · Phase 1 · P1-304 Drum-top vibratory sifter (built in house) · rev B
UNLESS NOTED: LINEAR ±0.5 [±.02] · HOLES +0.2/-0 · ANGLES ±0.5° · MACHINED X.X ±0.1, X.XX ±0.05 · THIRD-ANGLE PROJECTION · BREAK EDGES 0.5 · ASME Y14.5

svg.text: DETAIL B (1:1): ISOLATOR STACK, RADIAL SECTION AT 330°
DETAIL C (2:1): SCREEN DECK, LEDGE, LID PAD

g.text: 12 MESH CLOTH P1-305 clamped between the rings,
rings TIG tacked through the cloth (P1-304-400)
fillet weld W4 top, seal weld under

svg.text: 1. Product path: valve sock > 4 in inlet > screen deck (overs stay on the deck, cleared each batch) > grate magnet > drum liner.
2. No ledges or threads in the product zone: bars and ledge are fully seal-welded and ground; deck and magnet lift out.
3. Screen open area 52 %, 15.9 dm² of 12 mesh: rated about 16 kg/min against 3.6 kg/min target.
4. Gaskets FDA silicone; deck sits on the ledge gasket and is held by 3 lid pads (no screws).
